### The Birth of Seth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/birth-seth
Passage: Genesis 4:25–26
Points:
- God chose to fulfill His redemptive promise through Seth rather than Cain's unrepentant line.
- Eve named Seth in faith, recognizing him as the appointed seed granted to replace Abel.
- The birth of Enosh coincided with the emergence of public worship and testimony about God.
- Cultural and civilizational achievements remain empty without genuine devotion to the Lord.
- Seth's lineage ultimately leads to Jesus Christ, who decisively defeats Satan and sin.

### The Very First Prayer: Why Man Began to Call on God
Author: Gary Millar
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-very-first-prayer
Passage: Genesis 4:25–26
Points:
- Calling upon the Lord after Enosh's birth represents the first recorded prayer after the fall.
- Waiting for the promised serpent-crusher prompted God's people to cry out to Him.
- At its core, biblical prayer is asking God to accomplish what He has already promised.
- Centering prayer on God's gospel commitments clears away confusion and performance-driven guilt.
- Believers are called to keep praying with kingdom focus until God's promises reach complete fulfillment.
